content.text:
Fixed it. All 18 tests now pass (`Ran 18 tests in 0.001s — OK`). The only file changed is `fiscal/calendar.py`, and I haven't committed it.

| Bug | Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `_nearest_saturday` only ever moved back to the Saturday on or before Jan 31 | The year end could never fall in February (FY2024 ended Jan 25, 2025 instead of Feb 1), so early-February sales landed in the next fiscal year and 53-week years were counted wrong | It now picks the Saturday within 3 days of Jan 31, earlier or later |
| `_period_lengths` added the 53rd week to period 1 (`lengths[0]`) | In long years every period was off by a week | The 53rd week now goes to period 12 (`lengths[-1]`), as SPEC §4 says |

`fiscal_week` and `weeks_in_year` were wrong only because of the year-end bug, so fixing that also fixed them without touching their code.

Because the bug moved year ends by a week, it also changed which years come out as 53 weeks. Any merch reports already generated for affected years may need to be re-run.
